purpose: Describe an action as going to a notable or excessive extent.
keywords: There is no need to stay up all night just to finish it today.
I do not want to win at the cost of lying to my friends.
I asked why she had wanted to meet so badly that she came from far away.
restrictions: Often questions whether the cost or sacrifice is justified.
mistake: Unlike てでも, it does not necessarily express positive determination.
